name: pumi-kanban
description: A board of cards for pumi: write a brief, drag the card to start a coding agent on it in a pane of its own, and the board follows it — queued, in progress, needs you, done.

agent.label: Agent command
agent.desc: The command line a card's agent starts with, when the card has none of its own. It runs in a terminal pane, in the card's folder.

open.label: Where an agent opens
open.desc: `beside` puts the agent's pane to the right of the board, so both stay in view; `tab` gives it a tab of its own.

close_on_land.label: Close the agent when a card is done
close_on_land.desc: Finishing a card closes its pane. Off, the pane stays open and the card is still filed as done.

notify.label: Say when a card needs you
notify.desc: A notification when an agent blocks, fails or finishes its turn — a card coming to rest in Needs you while you were looking elsewhere.

keep_landed.label: Finished cards kept
keep_landed.desc: How many finished cards the board keeps. The oldest go when a new one is finished.

key.label: Key
key.desc: A chord that opens the board from anywhere (the root key table). Empty for none.
